## Role in the Rating Process

The [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd) acts as a backstop provider through credit lines and programs, supporting the assessment of [Backstop Eligibility](../parameters/backstop-eligibility.qmd) (R6). Its loans, along with the legacy loans of its predecessor, the European Financial Stability Facility, are categorized as off-market financing, which informs the [Refinancing Need](../parameters/refinancing-need.qmd) parameter (R1-A*).

## Evidence by Country

### [Cyprus](../countries/cyprus.qmd)

- Cyprus maintains ongoing repayments to the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd), with approximately EUR 1 billion scheduled for May 2026. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 14-15" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 14-15">ⓘ</button>
- The public debt maturity profile is favorable, but 34.1% of the debt is based on a floating interest rate, which consists mostly of loans from the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd). <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 14" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 14">ⓘ</button>

### [Greece](../countries/greece.qmd)

- [Greece](../countries/greece.qmd) holds outstanding debt of EUR 59.8 billion to the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd). <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 10" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 10">ⓘ</button>
- Improvements in the banking sector’s resilience, noted by the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd), contributed to [Greece](../countries/greece.qmd)’s sovereign credit rating upgrade. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="oecd/economic-surveys/Greece_2024-12-05, p. 21" aria-label="Source: oecd/economic-surveys/Greece_2024-12-05, p. 21">ⓘ</button>

### [Ireland](../countries/ireland.qmd)

- No specific new evidence regarding the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd) is cited in this report, beyond general institutional participation. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2">ⓘ</button>

### [Portugal](../countries/portugal.qmd)

- The institution is mentioned in the context of backstop eligibility and the institutional framework. No direct support is cited in the previous report period beyond general eligibility assessments. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/country-reports/Portugal_2026-06-03, p. 1" aria-label="Source: ec/country-reports/Portugal_2026-06-03, p. 1">ⓘ</button>
- Staff from the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd) participated in meetings on aspects related to its Early Warning System. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2, 10, 14-15" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2, 10, 14-15">ⓘ</button>

### Euro Area

- Staff from the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd) participated in post-programme surveillance missions conducted by the [European Commission](../institutions/european-commission.qmd), in liaison with the [European Central Bank](../institutions/european-central-bank.qmd) and the [International Monetary Fund](../institutions/international-monetary-fund.qmd). <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2">ⓘ</button>
- The [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd) is invited as an observer to the Debt Sustainability Analysis working group of the [European Commission](../institutions/european-commission.qmd). <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 118" aria-label="Source: ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 118">ⓘ</button>
